program_overview.title: Data Science Complete Masterclass
program_overview.tagline: The full pipeline, honestly taught: Python, statistics and SQL, machine learning that holds up, then deep learning, ending with a capstone you deploy.
program_overview.description:
Data science hiring has grown sceptical: everyone lists the same libraries, so interviews now dig for the difference between importing scikit-learn and understanding what the model just did. This live online masterclass builds that difference in order: Python with NumPy and Pandas properly, statistics that survive contact with real data, SQL and EDA as daily craft, then machine learning done honestly, regression to ensembles with evaluation you can defend, real end-to-end projects and Kaggle practice, then the deep learning layer: neural networks, CNNs, RNNs and NLP, applied computer vision and a research-paper implementation to prove you can read the field. A finale month ships a deployed capstone and sits the final exam.

The pace is honest: ten teaching months at two live classes a week plus four to six hours of practice, with two more in hand. Problem sets, monthly mixed reviews, phase exams, and a final exam that decides the certificate with a free retest.
what_makes_this_different: Statistics before models: evaluation and honesty are the actual job
End-to-end from mid-course: raw data to working model, not notebook fragments
Kaggle as training ground, framed honestly: practice, not trophies
A research-paper implementation: proof you can read the field, not just tutorials
An honest 10-month arc with 2 months in hand
Real assessment: weekly problem sets, monthly mixed reviews, phase exams and a final exam with a free retest

faqs.question: What does this data science course cover?
faqs.answer: The full pipeline in order: Python with NumPy and Pandas, statistics, data visualization, SQL and exploratory data analysis with feature engineering; then machine learning, regression, classification, ensembles and unsupervised methods with honest evaluation, end-to-end projects and Kaggle practice; then deep learning, neural networks, CNNs, RNNs, NLP, applied computer vision and a research-paper implementation. A finale month ships a deployed capstone and sits the final exam.

faqs.question: How long does it take to learn data science properly?
faqs.answer: Ten months of teaching at 2 live classes a week plus 4 to 6 hours of practice, with two more months in hand for learners who need them. The three teaching phases build the skill and its real-world application; the finale month ships a capstone and sits the final exam.

faqs.question: How am I assessed? Is the certificate just for attending?
faqs.answer: No. Problem sets follow every class with written feedback, monthly reviews deliberately mix new material with earlier topics, each phase ends with a cumulative exam, and the course ends with a final exam: a practical build plus written questions from the whole syllabus. Passing earns the certificate; falling short earns focused revision and a free retest.

faqs.question: How is this different from your data analysis and AI/ML courses?
faqs.answer: Three different jobs. Data analysis is the business-facing craft: Excel, SQL, dashboards and clear answers to business questions. This data science course is the full modelling pipeline: statistics, machine learning and deep learning on top of that data craft. The AI/ML engineering course goes deepest into models and the systems that serve them. If you want the classic data scientist profile, this is the course; the other two are its neighbours.

faqs.question: Do I need strong maths before joining?
faqs.answer: No: school-level comfort with numbers is enough to start, and the statistics you need is taught inside the course, in code, on real data. What we do not do is hide the maths that matters: probability, distributions and evaluation metrics are taught properly because interviews and real work both reach for them.

faqs.question: What are the fees?
faqs.answer: Group classes are ₹1,499 per month, with 2 live classes a week in batches capped at 10 learners. A mini batch of 3-4 learners is ₹2,999 per month, and personal 1-on-1 classes are ₹4,999 per month. International learners pay a price set for their own country, shown on this page in their local currency.
